svg.title: Payment before fulfilment
svg.desc: A proposed commercial control model, not a live shop. Verified events enter the ledger; approved policy bounds fulfilment, shipment evidence returns to the same ledger, and a browser redirect is not payment proof. System model: Payment before fulfilment. Checkout Payment provider. Signed event Payment · order Event ID. VERIFY + DEDUPLICATE. ORDER LEDGER. HUMAN / APPROVED POLICY Artwork · rights · price Spend and fulfilment limits. Printful order Only within approved limits. Shipment event Update the same ledger. Notify the customer.. Browser redirect Not payment proof. Reject as payment proof. Notify the customer. Proposed commercial control model, not a live shop or sales claim. Signed events must be verified and deduplicated. Browser redirects have no route to the ledger.
